name: phil/route-access-check
description: Checks in continuous integration that every route of an application has an access rule: #[IsGranted], access_control entries read with Symfony's request matchers, firewalls without security, and #[PublicRoute] or a route option for the routes public on purpose; with conflicts, unused entries, a baseline and text, JSON, GitHub and JUnit reports

suggest.phil/route-access-check-bundle: To run the check as a console command of a Symfony application, from its router and security configuration
suggest.symfony/security-http: For the #[IsGranted] attributes the check reads
